summary: Verified Phase 2 safety-critical refactor of backend/routers/cto_projects.py. Backend boots cleanly; /api/aurem-dev/auth/login returns 200. All 6 new tests in test_cto_worker_safety_pipeline_2026_09_08.py PASS, proving: (a) Step-1 before/after snapshot: git-worker previously missing hallucination/syntax/lint gates now has all three; api-worker still has full pipeline unchanged; both call the SAME shared module-level functions in the same relative order. (b) Git-worker runs full safety pipeline end-to-end and reaches success via git-binary commit (not gh_api_commit). (c) Git-worker REJECTS bad codegen (syntax error / hallucinated file content) with status=failed and NO git add/commit/push subprocess calls are ever issued -- this is the exact safety proof requested. (d) API-worker behavior byte-identical (still commits via gh_api_commit, full pipeline intact). Regression pass over the 15 requested cto_projects test files: 293 passed, 2 failed, 1 deselected. The 2 failures (test_new_user_wizard_component_exists, test_wizard_wired_into_dashboard in test_iter73_wizard_and_parallel.py) are the pre-existing frontend/wizard failures the main agent flagged -- confirmed unrelated to cto_projects.py refactor. The 3rd claimed pre-existing failure (test_bug2_update_project_encrypts_pat) is not present in current collection under the named files (likely renamed/removed previously); not a regression from this round. No behavior drift detected in error wording, log messages, or commit mechanism beyond the 3 explicitly authorized new safety checks on the git-binary path.

minor.issue: Benign RuntimeWarning: coroutine '_gh_list_files' was never awaited surfaces during test_git_worker_rejects_bad_codegen (mock did not await); does not affect assertions or production behavior.

critical_code_review_comments: cto_projects.py is now >4000 lines and even after this extraction remains a god-file. The deferred package split (blocked this round because it would silently no-op ~40 patch.object() call sites) is a real technical debt item -- recommend a follow-up round that combines the split WITH a mechanical rewrite of the mocking pattern (e.g. patch('backend.routers.cto_projects.workers.git_worker._sh') OR route all patches via a single re-exported namespace) so the split can land safely.

The 3 new shared gate functions (_run_hallucination_gate/_run_syntax_gate/_run_lint_gate) are now the single source of truth for pre-commit safety on both worker paths -- excellent DRY move. Consider adding a docstring block at the top of each explicitly stating 'INVARIANT: must be called before every commit on every worker path, in this order' so future contributors don't fork the behavior again.

Both workers still have separate commit mechanisms (gh_api_commit vs git binary) by design and per the refactor charter -- flagging only as a discoverability note: the divergence between the two commit tails is not obvious from reading the top of the file.
